properties.description:
storm damage to commercial/municipal roofs | Storm 2026-03-10 ~10:30 PM CDT; article 2026-03-23

properties.name: Kankakee School District 111 – all 12 buildings (Kankakee HS
properties.description:
storm damage to commercial/municipal roofs | Storm 2026-03-10; articles 2026-03-15, 2026-03-26, 2026-05-01
Hail (record 6"+ stones) and EF-3 tornado: "thousands and thousands of holes" in the KHS roof; insurers called 9 of 12 roofs a total loss; by May 1 damage estimated $28.7M, roof damage to all 12 buildings (10 must be replaced) ≈ $21M; repairs over 2–3 years; priorities KHS, Aroma Park bldg, Kennedy MS, Kankakee JHS; several million in rooftop HVAC too; older (20+ yr) roofs covered at actual cash value.
Contact: District central office (Asst. Supt. of Business Services quoted: Lyle/Harrison Neal; Supt. Dr. Teresa Lance) · 815-802-7730 (district main)
Source: https://www.shawlocal.com/daily-journal/2026/04/30/storm-damage-nears-30m-for-kankakee-school-district/ ; https://www.shawlocal.com/daily-journal/2026/03/26/kankakee-schools-assessing-storm-damage/
